title: Pullback component of dense-open cohomology comparison
statement: For the data of lem-pbc-s2-dense-open-high-cohomology, every open-immersion pullback of the counit map induces a bijection on H^2.

proof.text: Construct the reduced closed complement using the vanishing ideal of the closed set X minus U. Mathlib IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι and vanishingIdeal support identify its range with this complement. Apply shortExact_openClosedShortComplex to its inclusion i and U.ι. Its first arrow is definitionally the extension-by-zero counit.

Forget module coefficients, using the proved private shortExact_underlying_abelian helper: the forgetful sheaf functor preserves finite limits by composing with sheafToPresheaf, and it preserves local surjectivity because sections have the same underlying functions. Hence it preserves short exact sequences. Pull this sequence back along a by ShortExact.map_of_exact. Its first arrow is definitionally the displayed a^* epsilon.
Apply dense_open_complement_pullback_vanishing to G=i^*F. Its conclusions for q=1 and q=2 make H^1 and H^2 of the pulled-back third term subsingletons.

For injectivity, an element x killed by H^2(R.f) is the connecting image of y in H^1(R.X3) by exact_δSucc_map. The first vanishing gives y=0, so x=0. For surjectivity, every y in H^2(R.X2) maps to zero in H^2(R.X3) by the second vanishing, and exact_map_map supplies a preimage. Pair these conclusions; no naturality ladder or chosen identification of the first arrow is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem dense_open_high_cohomology_pullback (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    let ε := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).counit.app F)
    ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (a : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion a],
      Function.Bijective
        (Sheaf.H.map (((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map ε) 2)
